name: 50126 · Iowa Falls, IA
findings: ZIP 50126 (Iowa Falls) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 7 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50126 (Iowa Falls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
